header.title: CollapseTransition
header.description: Collapse / expand along `height` or `width` (`collapsedSize` ↔ measured px → `auto`) for accordions and menus. Toggle `isIn`; with `collapsedSize` `0` the node unmounts after exit (unless `preserveSpace` / `keepMounted`). A non-zero `collapsedSize` keeps a visible peek.

base.description: With defaults (`dimension="height"`, `collapsedSize={0}`, `duration={300}`) expand measures content, animates to that px, then settles on `auto`. On exit it collapses to `0` and unmounts.

collapsedSize.title: collapsedSize (peek)
collapsedSize.description: Non-zero `collapsedSize` keeps a peek and leaves the node mounted (no opacity fade on out).

texts.panelFirst: First lines stay visible when collapsed — useful for a preview strip or drawer handle.

preserveSpace.title: preserveSpace
preserveSpace.description: With `preserveSpace`, layout height stays reserved while the panel fades out. Put borders on the transitioning node (`asChild`) so chrome disappears with opacity.

texts.panel: Bordered panel — border fades with the content; the gap stays so the sibling does not jump.
texts.sibling: Sibling below — stays put while the panel is hidden.

keepMounted.title: keepMounted
keepMounted.description: With `keepMounted`, exit keeps the host mounted and visually hidden (axis size `0`, no unmount). Re-enter measures again and expands the same DOM node.

initial.title: initial false
initial.description: `initial={false}` skips motion on the first mount (snaps in). Later toggles still collapse. Use Remount to see the skip again.

header.title: CollapseTransition API
header.description: Props, inheritance, accessibility, CSS classes and variables, and exported types for `CollapseTransition`.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: Playground and examples for presence, peek, width, and preserveSpace.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import from `@gem-org/gemsitions/collapse-transition` with its `collapse-transition.css`, or from the root if you already load `styles.css`.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Accepts HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> and forwards them to the root div, or to the child with asChild. In that case classes and styles merge with the child's, and if both define the same handler, the child's runs first. The component handles onTransitionEnd internally (to detect the end of height / width) and then calls yours.

items.presence: This is a presence transition: the control that toggles isIn should expose aria-expanded (or the disclosure pattern you use).
items.reducedMotion: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the host snaps to the final state. The preference is read each render; it is not live-listened.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: ignoreReducedMotion keeps the animation and adds gemst-ignore-reduced-motion on the root. Use only when motion is essential.
items.trigger: The accordion trigger and collapsing panel should not nest interactive buttons. Hidden content should not receive focus while isIn is false (with collapsedSize 0 the node unmounts).
items.preserveSpace: With preserveSpace space stays reserved and content hides with opacity. Do not put the border on a parent shared with always-visible UI — put it on the transitioning node.
items.asChild: With asChild, pick a child with the right semantics (Card, section, div): that element is the size host.

items.root: Root (`div`, or the child with `asChild`). `overflow: hidden` while animating.
items.dimension: Active axis (`height` or `width`). Defines which property transitions.
items.out: Absent state. Without peek, opacity goes to `0`.
items.expanded: Settled open with size `auto`. Sets `overflow: visible`.
items.preserveSpace: With `preserveSpace` on exit: keeps layout and clears border / background / shadow.
items.keepMountedHidden: Host hidden after exit with `keepMounted` (visibility + axis at `0`).

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: Written inline each render (`0ms` when `isDisabled`, reduced motion, or keep-mounted hidden).

items.duration: Duration of the current phase. Default `300ms`.
items.delay: Delay of the current phase. Default `0ms`.
items.easing: Easing of the current phase. Default `standard`.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: Global gemsitions variables used as CSS defaults.

items.easingStandard: Default for `--gemst-collapse-easing`. The component writes the resolved curve inline — use `easing` to change it.

content.title: Content
content.description: What collapses and where it mounts.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Presence, axis, peek, and how it stays mounted.

timing.title: Timing
timing.description: In milliseconds. `enter` applies on expand and `exit` on collapse.

events.title: Events
events.description: Presence cycle, phases, and axis measure.

items.children: Content that collapses and expands. Without `asChild` it is wrapped in the surface.
items.asChild: Applies classes, styles, and ref to the single child. No `__surface`.
items.isIn: `true` expands to content size then `auto`; `false` collapses to `collapsedSize` and unmounts when `0` (unless preserve/keep/peek).
items.collapsedSize: Size when collapsed. Number = px; string = any CSS length. Non-zero keeps a peek and stays mounted. Default `0`.
items.preserveSpace: On exit, keeps layout size (hides with opacity; axis does not collapse). Ignored when `unmountOnExit`.
items.keepMounted: After exit the host stays mounted and hidden (axis at `0`). Ignored when `unmountOnExit`.
items.initial: `false` skips motion on the first mount. Later toggles still animate. Default `true`.
items.duration: Duration. With `{ enter, exit }`, `enter` is expand and `exit` is collapse.
items.delay: Wait before starting. Accepts `{ enter, exit }`.
items.easing: Token (`standard`, `enter`, `exit`, `emphasized`, `linear`), timing function, or `{ enter, exit }`. Default `standard`.
items.isDisabled: Snaps to the target state with no interpolation.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: Animates even when the user prefers reduced motion. Only if essential.
items.onCollapse: Fires when the collapse is active (`isIn` true).
items.outCollapse: Fires on exit (`isIn` false), disable, or unmount.
items.onDimensionChange: Live size on the animated axis (`scrollHeight` / `scrollWidth`), in px.
items.style: Inline styles for the root. Combined with the animated size and `--gemst-collapse-*`.
items.ref: Ref to the root (the `div`, or the child with `asChild`).
